# MCP reference

What `ynm serve` exposes to an MCP client: ten tools, four resources and three prompts,
generated from the server definition. Every tool has a CLI command with the same input; see
the [CLI reference](cli.md).

## Server instructions

Sent to the client in the `initialize` result:

> ynm gives you persistent memory. Read memory_context (or call memory_recall with the task's key terms) before answering questions about the project, the user or past decisions. Record durable facts with memory_remember: one memory per fact, personal by default, distributed only for team-safe project facts, never secrets. Prefer memory_supersede over duplicates.

## Tools

| Tool | CLI command | Read-only | Destructive |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`memory_remember`](#memory_remember) | [`ynm remember`](cli.md#ynm-remember) | no | no |
| [`memory_recall`](#memory_recall) | [`ynm recall`](cli.md#ynm-recall) | yes | no |
| [`memory_context`](#memory_context) | [`ynm context`](cli.md#ynm-context) | yes | no |
| [`memory_supersede`](#memory_supersede) | [`ynm supersede`](cli.md#ynm-supersede) | no | no |
| [`memory_annotate`](#memory_annotate) | [`ynm annotate`](cli.md#ynm-annotate) | no | no |
| [`memory_forget`](#memory_forget) | [`ynm forget`](cli.md#ynm-forget) | no | yes |
| [`memory_session`](#memory_session) | [`ynm session`](cli.md#ynm-session) | no | no |
| [`memory_consolidate`](#memory_consolidate) | [`ynm dream`](cli.md#ynm-dream) | no | no |
| [`memory_sync`](#memory_sync) | [`ynm sync`](cli.md#ynm-sync) | no | no |
| [`memory_status`](#memory_status) | [`ynm status`](cli.md#ynm-status) | yes | no |

A tool result carries the payload as JSON text and as `structuredContent: { data, guidance }`.
When `guidance` is set it is also appended to the text after a blank line as
`Guidance: ...`. A failed call returns `isError: true` with the message as text.

### memory_remember

Record a memory. Choose type (semantic facts, episodic events, procedural how-to, reference pointers, working scratch) and level (personal by default; distributed only for team-safe project facts). Never store secrets.

CLI: `ynm remember`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `working` \| `episodic` \| `semantic` \| `procedural` \| `reflective` \| `reference` | yes |  | Memory type (ADR-001) |
| `level` | `personal` \| `distributed` |  | `personal` | personal never leaves the user's store by default |
| `namespace` | string (max 512) |  | `common` | Hierarchical namespace, e.g. common, user/david, org/eyelock/project/ynm, session/<id> |
| `content` | string (max 65536) | yes |  | Markdown; the memory itself |
| `summary` | string (max 280) |  |  | One line summary; derived from content if omitted |
| `subject` | string (max 200) |  |  | Entity or topic key |
| `tags` | array of string (max 64) |  | `[]` | Free-form tags |
| `data` | object |  |  | Structured payload (JSON object) |
| `dataSchema` | string (max 100) |  |  | Name of the shape of data |
| `importance` | number 0..1 |  | `0.5` | 0..1 |
| `confidence` | number 0..1 |  | `1` | 0..1 |
| `validFrom` | date-time |  |  | When it became true |
| `validTo` | date-time |  |  | When it stopped being true |
| `ttl` | string |  |  | Working memory TTL; defaults to PT8H for type working |
| `session` | string |  |  | Session id for provenance |
| `source` | string |  |  | Source reference for provenance |
| `links` | array of object |  | `[]` | Typed links to other memories |
| `links[].rel` | `supersedes` \| `derives-from` \| `contradicts` \| `supports` \| `about` \| `in-session` | yes |  |  |
| `links[].to` | string | yes |  | memoryId of the target |

### memory_recall

Search memory: indexed and ranked by relevance, recency and importance. Use before answering questions about the project, the user or past decisions.

CLI: `ynm recall`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string (max 2000) |  |  | Free text; omit to filter and rank by recency and importance only |
| `type` | array of `working` \| `episodic` \| `semantic` \| `procedural` \| `reflective` \| `reference` |  |  | Restrict to these memory types |
| `level` | array of `personal` \| `distributed` |  |  | Restrict to these levels |
| `namespace` | string |  |  | Namespace prefix |
| `subject` | string |  |  | Exact subject key |
| `tags` | array of string |  |  | All of these tags must be present |
| `dataKey` | string |  |  | Only memories whose data has this key |
| `since` | date-time |  |  | Updated at or after |
| `until` | date-time |  |  | Updated at or before |
| `pinnedOnly` | boolean |  | `false` | Only pinned memories |
| `includeTombstoned` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `limit` | integer 1..200 |  | `10` |  |
| `explain` | boolean |  | `false` | Return score components |
| `rerank` | boolean |  |  | Judge-backed rerank of the top candidates (default from config) |
| `mount` | string |  |  | Only this mount |

### memory_context

The session-start memory block: pinned memories first, then the most relevant, packed to a token budget. Read it at the start of a task.

CLI: `ynm context`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | string |  |  | Namespace prefix |
| `level` | array of `personal` \| `distributed` |  |  |  |
| `type` | array of `working` \| `episodic` \| `semantic` \| `procedural` \| `reflective` \| `reference` |  |  |  |
| `text` | string (max 2000) |  |  | Optional focus text for the ranked part |
| `budgetTokens` | integer 1..50000 |  | `1500` | Approximate token budget |
| `mount` | string |  |  |  |

### memory_supersede

Record a new version of an existing memory. Use when a remembered fact is wrong or incomplete instead of creating a duplicate.

CLI: `ynm supersede`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string (max 65536) | yes |  | Markdown; the memory itself |
| `summary` | string (max 280) |  |  | One line summary; derived from content if omitted |
| `subject` | string (max 200) |  |  | Entity or topic key |
| `tags` | array of string (max 64) |  | `[]` | Free-form tags |
| `data` | object |  |  | Structured payload (JSON object) |
| `dataSchema` | string (max 100) |  |  | Name of the shape of data |
| `importance` | number 0..1 |  | `0.5` | 0..1 |
| `confidence` | number 0..1 |  | `1` | 0..1 |
| `validFrom` | date-time |  |  | When it became true |
| `validTo` | date-time |  |  | When it stopped being true |
| `session` | string |  |  | Session id for provenance |
| `source` | string |  |  | Source reference for provenance |
| `links` | array of object |  | `[]` | Typed links to other memories |
| `links[].rel` | `supersedes` \| `derives-from` \| `contradicts` \| `supports` \| `about` \| `in-session` | yes |  |  |
| `links[].to` | string | yes |  | memoryId of the target |
| `memoryId` | string | yes |  | Memory to supersede |

### memory_annotate

Add tags, links, pin, importance or review flags to a memory without changing its content.

CLI: `ynm annotate`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memoryId` | string | yes |  | Memory to annotate |
| `tags` | array of string (max 64) |  |  | Tags to add |
| `links` | array of object |  |  | Links to add |
| `links[].rel` | `supersedes` \| `derives-from` \| `contradicts` \| `supports` \| `about` \| `in-session` | yes |  |  |
| `links[].to` | string | yes |  | memoryId of the target |
| `importance` | number 0..1 |  |  | New importance |
| `confidence` | number 0..1 |  |  | New confidence |
| `pinned` | boolean |  |  | Pin or unpin |
| `needsReview` | boolean |  |  | Flag or clear review |
| `reason` | string (max 1000) |  |  | Why |
| `session` | string |  |  |  |
| `data` | object |  |  | Judgment or other structured annotation data |

### memory_forget

Tombstone a memory so it stops being recalled. History is kept; a later supersede can revive it.

CLI: `ynm forget`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memoryId` | string | yes |  | Memory to tombstone |
| `reason` | string (max 1000) |  |  | Why |
| `session` | string |  |  |  |

### memory_session

Start a session (returns a session id, its working-memory namespace and the context block) or end one (expires working memory).

CLI: `ynm session`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `start` \| `end` | yes |  | start or end a session |
| `sessionId` | string |  |  | Session id (required for end) |
| `namespace` | string |  |  | Namespace prefix for the context block |
| `budgetTokens` | integer 1..50000 |  | `1500` |  |
| `ttl` | string |  | `PT8H` | Default working-memory TTL |
| `expire` | boolean |  | `true` | On end: tombstone expired working memory |

### memory_consolidate

Run consolidation passes. Currently: expire (tombstone working memory past its ttl). Model-backed passes arrive later.

CLI: `ynm dream`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passes` | array of `expire` \| `promote` \| `dedupe` \| `contradict` \| `reflect` \| `normalise` |  | `["expire","promote","dedupe","contradict","reflect","normalise"]` | Passes to run |
| `namespace` | string |  |  | Restrict to a namespace prefix |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | `false` | Report what would change |
| `maxPairs` | integer >= 1 |  |  | Cap on judged pairs this run |

### memory_sync

Fetch, merge and push shared memory with the configured remote. Personal memory is never synced by this tool.

CLI: `ynm sync`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `remote` | string |  |  | Remote name |
| `push` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `pull` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `mount` | string |  |  | Only this mount |

### memory_status

Mounts, shard counts and index freshness.

CLI: `ynm status`.

No input fields.

## Resources

| URI | MIME type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `memory://status` | `application/json` | Mounts, shard counts and index freshness |
| `memory://context` | `text/markdown` | The session-start memory block (pinned first, then ranked) |
| `memory://{mount}/{memoryId}` | `application/json` | One memory by mount and id, as JSON (template) |
| `memory://{mount}/wiki/{+path}` | `text/markdown` | A page of the markdown projection: index.md, log.md, memories/<id>.md, entities/<slug>.md, topics/<slug>.md (template) |

## Prompts

Each prompt takes no arguments and returns one user message holding a guidance document. The
same documents are written into client instructions by `ynm client install`.

| Prompt | Description |
|---|---|
| `memory-session-start` | ynm guidance: session start |
| `memory-when-to-remember` | ynm guidance: when to remember |
| `memory-when-to-promote` | ynm guidance: when to promote |
